name: Magpie Board
tagline: Run your HOA without becoming the villain of the neighborhood group chat.
positioning: Magpie Board is HOA software for the volunteer board members and homeowners who never asked for this job but got it anyway.

hero.h1: HOA management that won't make you the block's most hated person.
hero.sub: Collect dues, log violations, publish minutes, and answer the same three questions 40 times — all in one place your neighbors can't argue with. Probably.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Auto-invoice every unit, chase the chronic late payers with polite-but-firm reminders, and see who owes what without opening a single spreadsheet named 'FINAL_v7'.

features.title: Violations, minus the drama
features.description: Log the rogue trampoline or the beige-that-should've-been-taupe with photos, timestamps, and a paper trail that holds up at the next shouting match, sorry, meeting.

features.title: Minutes people actually read
features.description: Turn a two-hour meeting into a clean, shareable recap in minutes. Attach the budget, tag decisions, and stop the 'wait, what did we vote on?' emails.

features.title: A vote nobody can dispute
features.description: Run online ballots for bylaws, budgets, and that eternal pool-hours debate. Every vote is logged, quorum is counted for you, and Karen can check the receipts.

features.title: Requests in one inbox
features.description: Maintenance tickets, ARC requests, and gate-code pleas land in a single queue instead of your personal cell phone at 11pm on a Sunday.

features.title: Documents that don't vanish
features.description: Bylaws, insurance, reserve studies, and vendor contracts live in one searchable vault — not on the last treasurer's dead laptop.

testimonials.quote: I inherited three binders and a shoebox of checks. Two weeks with Magpie Board and I finally know who paid dues and who's just very confident they did.
testimonials.name: Dana Reyes

testimonials.quote: Our violation letters used to start neighborhood feuds. Now there's a timestamp and a photo, so the arguing happens with the facts instead of me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: We ran our first online budget vote and got 71% turnout. Previously our record was nine people and a folding table in the clubhouse.
testimonials.name: Priya Malhotra

pricing.blurb: For the tiny association run entirely on goodwill and one exhausted neighbor.
For a real HOA that wants dues, votes, and violations in one honest place.
For larger communities or the manager juggling several at once.

homepage.footerBlurb: Magpie Board — HOA software for people who'd rather not be doing this. Built for boards, treasurers, and the neighbor who volunteered by accident.
